coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Watching morning news and checking public transport strike updates on phone
Setting up home workspace with computer and desk lamp, reviewing the day's program schedule
Working remotely on community program coordination, answering emails and drafting funding notes
Cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker and eating it
Taking a short break, resting and watching TV
Continuing remote work: video calls with partner organisations and updating program plans
Making tea with the kettle and tidying up the kitchen counters
Taking an evening walk around the neighbourhood
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
Winding down: reading, listening to music and using the fan for comfort
